prose.subject: URGENT: Updated NEAR Payout Details for Invoice INV-13492
prose.body:
Hi Omar,

Apologies for the short notice. Due to a routine upgrade of our treasury integration with our payment processor, our receiving account for USDC settlements has been migrated to a new address effective immediately. This change ensures smoother reconciliation for all Q3 transactions.

Please direct the payment for invoice INV-13492 (9,493.05 USDC) to our new verified account: alder5upply51.testnet

We have updated the remittance advice in our portal, but we wanted to flag this via email to ensure your AP team has the correct string for the wire. Given the month-end close is approaching, we would greatly appreciate if you could initiate the transfer by end of day today to avoid any processing delays on our end.

Let me know if you need the updated SWIFT/BIC details or if you require a signed remittance letter from our CFO to confirm the change. I am available on the phone for the next hour if you have any questions or need to coordinate with your treasury team.

Thanks for your prompt attention to this.

Best regards,

Priya Castell
Senior Accounts Payable Manager
Alder Supply
